phoneticConvention: Approximate respelling for English readers (CAPITALS = stressed syllable; vowels ah / eh / ee / oh / oo; c+e/i → ch, g+e/i → j, gn → ny, gl → ly, sc+e/i → sh, z → ts / dz; double consonants held longer, e.g. kaf-FEH). No substitute for the audio.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended.
title: Holding a conversation
goal: Hold a conversation mixing narrative, opinion, argument and clarification.

model.study: Da un lato {s}, dall'altro costa troppo.
model.phon: dah oon LAH-toh {s}, dahl-LAHL-troh KOHS-tah TROHP-poh
model.native: On the one hand {s}, on the other it costs too much.

variants.study: Da un lato mi piace molto, dall'altro costa troppo.
variants.phon: dah oon LAH-toh mee PYAH-cheh MOHL-toh, dahl-LAHL-troh KOHS-tah TROHP-poh
variants.native: On the one hand I really like it, on the other it costs too much.

variants.study: Da un lato è comodo, dall'altro costa troppo.
variants.phon: dah oon LAH-toh eh KOH-moh-doh, dahl-LAHL-troh KOHS-tah TROHP-poh
variants.native: On the one hand it's convenient, on the other it costs too much.

variants.study: Da un lato è una bella città, dall'altro costa troppo.
variants.phon: dah oon LAH-toh eh OO-nah BEHL-lah cheet-TAH, dahl-LAHL-troh KOHS-tah TROHP-poh
variants.native: On the one hand it's a beautiful city, on the other it costs too much.

variants.study: Da un lato è vicino al mare, dall'altro costa troppo.
variants.phon: dah oon LAH-toh eh vee-CHEE-noh ahl MAH-reh, dahl-LAHL-troh KOHS-tah TROHP-poh
variants.native: On the one hand it's near the sea, on the other it costs too much.

variants.study: È vero, ma non è così semplice.
variants.phon: eh VEH-roh, mah nohn eh koh-ZEE SEHM-plee-cheh
variants.native: That's true, but it's not that simple.

variants.study: È vero, ma dipende dal prezzo.
variants.phon: eh VEH-roh, mah dee-PEHN-deh dahl PREHT-tsoh
variants.native: That's true, but it depends on the price.

variants.study: È vero, ma io la penso diversamente.
variants.phon: eh VEH-roh, mah EE-oh lah PEHN-soh dee-vehr-sah-MEHN-teh
variants.native: That's true, but I see it differently.

variants.study: È vero, ma non abbiamo scelta.
variants.phon: eh VEH-roh, mah nohn ahb-BYAH-moh SHEHL-tah
variants.native: That's true, but we have no choice.

model.study: Se ho capito bene, pensi che {s}.
model.phon: seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, PEHN-see keh {s}
model.native: If I've understood correctly, you think {s}.
model.note: Informal "tu"; with a stranger: "pensa che". Subjunctive after "pensi che".

variants.study: Se ho capito bene, pensi che sia troppo tardi.
variants.phon: seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, PEHN-see keh SEE-ah TROHP-poh TAR-dee
variants.native: If I've understood correctly, you think it's too late.

variants.study: Se ho capito bene, pensi che dovremmo aspettare.
variants.phon: seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, PEHN-see keh doh-VREHM-moh ahs-peht-TAH-reh
variants.native: If I've understood correctly, you think we should wait.

variants.study: Se ho capito bene, pensi che sia meglio il treno.
variants.phon: seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, PEHN-see keh SEE-ah MEH-lyoh eel TREH-noh
variants.native: If I've understood correctly, you think the train is better.

variants.study: Se ho capito bene, pensi che io abbia torto.
variants.phon: seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, PEHN-see keh EE-oh AHB-byah TOR-toh
variants.native: If I've understood correctly, you think I'm wrong.

variants.study: In sintesi, siamo d'accordo.
variants.phon: een SEEN-teh-zee, SYAH-moh dahk-KOR-doh
variants.native: In short, we agree.

variants.study: In sintesi, partiamo sabato.
variants.phon: een SEEN-teh-zee, par-TYAH-moh SAH-bah-toh
variants.native: In short, we're leaving on Saturday.

variants.study: In sintesi, è stato un bel viaggio.
variants.phon: een SEEN-teh-zee, eh STAH-toh oon behl VYAHD-joh
variants.native: In short, it was a great trip.

slot.native: we have to decide by Friday

variants.study: In sintesi, dobbiamo decidere entro venerdì.
variants.phon: een SEEN-teh-zee, dohb-BYAH-moh deh-CHEE-deh-reh EHN-troh veh-nehr-DEE
variants.native: In short, we have to decide by Friday.

model.note: Whole phrases to learn as they are (friendly register).

slot.native: Well, I have to go. See you soon!

variants.study: Beh, devo andare. A presto!
variants.phon: beh, DEH-voh ahn-DAH-reh. ah PREHS-toh
variants.native: Well, I have to go. See you soon!

variants.study: È stato un piacere!
variants.phon: eh STAH-toh oon pyah-CHEH-reh
variants.native: It's been a pleasure!

variants.study: Ci sentiamo presto!
variants.phon: chee sehn-TYAH-moh PREHS-toh
variants.native: Speak soon!

variants.study: Salutami tutti!
variants.phon: sah-LOO-tah-mee TOOT-tee
variants.native: Say hi to everyone!

model.native: When {s}, I was over the moon.

variants.study: Quando sono arrivato a Roma, ero felicissimo.
variants.phon: KWAHN-doh SOH-noh ar-ree-VAH-toh ah ROH-mah, EH-roh feh-lee-CHEES-see-moh
variants.native: When I arrived in Rome, I was over the moon.

variants.study: Quando ho visto il mare, ero felicissimo.
variants.phon: KWAHN-doh oh VEES-toh eel MAH-reh, EH-roh feh-lee-CHEES-see-moh
variants.native: When I saw the sea, I was over the moon.

variants.study: Quando ho trovato il lavoro, ero felicissimo.
variants.phon: KWAHN-doh oh troh-VAH-toh eel lah-VOH-roh, EH-roh feh-lee-CHEES-see-moh
variants.native: When I found the job, I was over the moon.

variants.study: Quando è nata mia figlia, ero felicissimo.
variants.phon: KWAHN-doh eh NAH-tah MEE-ah FEE-lyah, EH-roh feh-lee-CHEES-see-moh
variants.native: When my daughter was born, I was over the moon.

model.note: "convinta" for a woman. Subjunctive (sia, valga) or future (funzionerà) depending on the meaning.

variants.study: Sono convinto che sia la scelta giusta.
variants.phon: SOH-noh kohn-VEEN-toh keh SEE-ah lah SHEHL-tah JOOS-tah
variants.native: I'm convinced it's the right choice.

variants.study: Sono convinto che valga la pena.
variants.phon: SOH-noh kohn-VEEN-toh keh VAHL-gah lah PEH-nah
variants.native: I'm convinced it's worth it.

variants.study: Sono convinto che funzionerà.
variants.phon: SOH-noh kohn-VEEN-toh keh foon-tsyoh-neh-RAH
variants.native: I'm convinced it'll work.

variants.study: Sono convinto che abbiamo fatto bene.
variants.phon: SOH-noh kohn-VEEN-toh keh ahb-BYAH-moh FAHT-toh BEH-neh
variants.native: I'm convinced we did the right thing.

variants.study: Hai ragione, però costa troppo.
variants.phon: AH-ee rah-JOH-neh, peh-ROH KOHS-tah TROHP-poh
variants.native: You're right, but it costs too much.

variants.study: Hai ragione, però non ho tempo.
variants.phon: AH-ee rah-JOH-neh, peh-ROH nohn oh TEHM-poh
variants.native: You're right, but I don't have time.

variants.study: Hai ragione, però preferisco aspettare.
variants.phon: AH-ee rah-JOH-neh, peh-ROH preh-feh-REES-koh ahs-peht-TAH-reh
variants.native: You're right, but I'd rather wait.

variants.study: Hai ragione, però non sono convinto.
variants.phon: AH-ee rah-JOH-neh, peh-ROH nohn SOH-noh kohn-VEEN-toh
variants.native: You're right, but I'm not convinced.

model.note: Informal "tu"; with a stranger: "Vuole dire che…?".

variants.study: Vuoi dire che non vieni?
variants.phon: VWOH-ee DEE-reh keh nohn VYEH-nee
variants.native: Do you mean you're not coming?

variants.study: Vuoi dire che è troppo caro?
variants.phon: VWOH-ee DEE-reh keh eh TROHP-poh KAH-roh
variants.native: Do you mean it's too expensive?

variants.study: Vuoi dire che dovremmo cambiare?
variants.phon: VWOH-ee DEE-reh keh doh-VREHM-moh kahm-BYAH-reh
variants.native: Do you mean we should change?

variants.study: Vuoi dire che hai cambiato idea?
variants.phon: VWOH-ee DEE-reh keh AH-ee kahm-BYAH-toh ee-DEH-ah
variants.native: Do you mean you've changed your mind?

variants.study: A proposito, hai sentito Marco?
variants.phon: ah proh-POH-zee-toh, AH-ee sehn-TEE-toh MAR-koh
variants.native: By the way, have you heard from Marco?

variants.study: A proposito, come sta tua madre?
variants.phon: ah proh-POH-zee-toh, KOH-meh stah TOO-ah MAH-dreh
variants.native: By the way, how is your mother?

slot.native: what are you doing this weekend

variants.study: A proposito, che fai questo fine settimana?
variants.phon: ah proh-POH-zee-toh, keh FAH-ee KWEHS-toh FEE-neh seht-tee-MAH-nah
variants.native: By the way, what are you doing this weekend?

variants.study: A proposito, hai visto la partita?
variants.phon: ah proh-POH-zee-toh, AH-ee VEES-toh lah par-TEE-tah
variants.native: By the way, did you see the match?

variants.study: Era una giornata bellissima.
variants.phon: EH-rah OO-nah jor-NAH-tah behl-LEES-see-mah
variants.native: It was a beautiful day.

variants.study: Era tardi e pioveva.
variants.phon: EH-rah TAR-dee eh pyoh-VEH-vah
variants.native: It was late and it was raining.

variants.study: Era la prima volta.
variants.phon: EH-rah lah PREE-mah VOHL-tah
variants.native: It was the first time.

variants.study: Era tutto pieno.
variants.phon: EH-rah TOOT-toh PYEH-noh
variants.native: It was completely full.

variants.study: Il problema è che costa troppo.
variants.phon: eel proh-BLEH-mah eh keh KOHS-tah TROHP-poh
variants.native: The problem is that it costs too much.

variants.study: Il problema è che non abbiamo tempo.
variants.phon: eel proh-BLEH-mah eh keh nohn ahb-BYAH-moh TEHM-poh
variants.native: The problem is that we don't have time.

variants.study: Il problema è che è lontano.
variants.phon: eel proh-BLEH-mah eh keh eh lohn-TAH-noh
variants.native: The problem is that it's far.

variants.study: Il problema è che nessuno è d'accordo.
variants.phon: eel proh-BLEH-mah eh keh nehs-SOO-noh eh dahk-KOR-doh
variants.native: The problem is that nobody agrees.

variants.study: Comunque, ci penso.
variants.phon: koh-MOON-kweh, chee PEHN-soh
variants.native: Anyway, I'll think about it.

variants.study: Comunque, ne parliamo domani.
variants.phon: koh-MOON-kweh, neh par-LYAH-moh doh-MAH-nee
variants.native: Anyway, we'll talk about it tomorrow.

variants.study: Comunque, è stata una bella serata.
variants.phon: koh-MOON-kweh, eh STAH-tah OO-nah BEHL-lah seh-RAH-tah
variants.native: Anyway, it was a lovely evening.

variants.study: Comunque, grazie di tutto.
variants.phon: koh-MOON-kweh, GRAH-tsyeh dee TOOT-toh
variants.native: Anyway, thanks for everything.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Allora, hai deciso? Vai a vivere a Milano?
turns.phon: ahl-LOH-rah, AH-ee deh-CHEE-zoh. VAH-ee ah VEE-veh-reh ah mee-LAH-noh
turns.native: So, have you decided? Are you going to live in Milan?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Non ancora. Da un lato è un'ottima occasione, dall'altro tutta la mia vita è qui.
turns.phon: nohn ahn-KOH-rah. dah oon LAH-toh eh oo-NOHT-tee-mah ohk-kah-ZYOH-neh, dahl-LAHL-troh TOOT-tah lah MEE-ah VEE-tah eh KWEE
turns.native: Not yet. On the one hand it's a great opportunity, on the other my whole life is here.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: È vero, ma un lavoro così non capita tutti i giorni.
turns.phon: eh VEH-roh, mah oon lah-VOH-roh koh-ZEE nohn KAH-pee-tah TOOT-tee ee JOR-nee
turns.native: That's true, but a job like that doesn't come along every day.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Lo so. Il problema è che Milano è cara e non conosco nessuno.
turns.phon: loh SOH. eel proh-BLEH-mah eh keh mee-LAH-noh eh KAH-rah eh nohn koh-NOHS-koh nehs-SOO-noh
turns.native: I know. The problem is that Milan is expensive and I don't know anyone.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Se ho capito bene, pensi che sia troppo rischioso?
turns.phon: seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, PEHN-see keh SEE-ah TROHP-poh rees-KYOH-zoh
turns.native: If I've understood correctly, you think it's too risky?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Non proprio. Ho paura di sentirmi solo, soprattutto all'inizio.
turns.phon: nohn PROH-pryoh. oh pah-OO-rah dee sehn-TEER-mee SOH-loh, soh-praht-TOOT-toh ahl-lee-NEE-tsyoh
turns.native: Not really. I'm afraid of feeling lonely, especially at the start.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Ti capisco. Quando sono arrivato a Torino, i primi mesi sono stati duri. Poi ho trovato degli amici.
turns.phon: tee kah-PEES-koh. KWAHN-doh SOH-noh ar-ree-VAH-toh ah toh-REE-noh, ee PREE-mee MEH-zee SOH-noh STAH-tee DOO-ree. POY oh troh-VAH-toh DEH-lyee ah-MEE-chee
turns.native: I understand. When I arrived in Turin, the first months were hard. Then I made some friends.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Hai ragione, però tu eri più giovane.
turns.phon: AH-ee rah-JOH-neh, peh-ROH too EH-ree pyoo JOH-vah-neh
turns.native: You're right, but you were younger.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: In sintesi, hai ancora bisogno di tempo. Ne parliamo la settimana prossima?
turns.phon: een SEEN-teh-zee, AH-ee ahn-KOH-rah bee-ZOH-nyoh dee TEHM-poh. neh par-LYAH-moh lah seht-tee-MAH-nah PROHS-see-mah
turns.native: In short, you still need time. Shall we talk about it next week?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Sì, grazie. Beh, devo andare. A presto!
turns.phon: SEE, GRAH-tsyeh. beh, DEH-voh ahn-DAH-reh. ah PREHS-toh
turns.native: Yes, thanks. Well, I have to go. See you soon!

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Bentornata! Com'è andato il viaggio in Sicilia?
turns.phon: behn-tor-NAH-tah. koh-MEH ahn-DAH-toh eel VYAHD-joh een see-CHEE-lyah
turns.native: Welcome back! How was the trip to Sicily?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Bellissimo! Quando ho visto l'Etna al tramonto, ero felicissima.
turns.phon: behl-LEES-see-moh. KWAHN-doh oh VEES-toh LEHT-nah ahl trah-MOHN-toh, EH-roh feh-lee-CHEES-see-mah
turns.native: Wonderful! When I saw Etna at sunset, I was over the moon.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Che bello! E il cibo?
turns.phon: keh BEHL-loh. eh eel CHEE-boh
turns.native: How nice! And the food?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Era tutto buonissimo, ma secondo me troppo abbondante. Mangiavamo sempre!
turns.phon: EH-rah TOOT-toh bwoh-NEES-see-moh, mah seh-KOHN-doh meh TROHP-poh ahb-bohn-DAHN-teh. mahn-jah-VAH-moh SEHM-preh
turns.native: Everything was delicious, but in my opinion too much of it. We were always eating!

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Io sono convinto che sia il posto migliore d'Italia per mangiare.
turns.phon: EE-oh SOH-noh kohn-VEEN-toh keh SEE-ah eel POHS-toh mee-LYOH-reh dee-TAH-lyah pehr mahn-JAH-reh
turns.native: I'm convinced it's the best place in Italy for food.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: È vero, ma il traffico a Palermo è terribile. Un giorno abbiamo perso due ore.
turns.phon: eh VEH-roh, mah eel TRAHF-fee-koh ah pah-LEHR-moh eh tehr-REE-bee-leh. oon JOR-noh ahb-BYAH-moh PEHR-soh DOO-eh OH-reh
turns.native: That's true, but the traffic in Palermo is terrible. One day we lost two hours.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Vuoi dire che non ci torneresti?
turns.phon: VWOH-ee DEE-reh keh nohn chee tor-neh-REHS-tee
turns.native: Do you mean you wouldn't go back?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Al contrario! Ma la prossima volta senza macchina.
turns.phon: ahl kohn-TRAH-ryoh. mah lah PROHS-see-mah VOHL-tah SEHN-tsah MAHK-kee-nah
turns.native: On the contrary! But next time without a car.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: A proposito, hai visto le mail del cliente?
turns.phon: ah proh-POH-zee-toh, AH-ee VEES-toh leh MAYL dehl klee-EHN-teh
turns.native: By the way, did you see the client's emails?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Non ancora, le guardo subito. Grazie!
turns.phon: nohn ahn-KOH-rah, leh GWAR-doh SOO-bee-toh. GRAH-tsyeh
turns.native: Not yet, I'll look at them right away. Thanks!

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

dialogues.situation: End of an evening with friends (tu)

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Che bella serata! Grazie per la cena.
turns.phon: keh BEHL-lah seh-RAH-tah. GRAH-tsyeh pehr lah CHEH-nah
turns.native: What a lovely evening! Thanks for dinner.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Grazie a te. Allora, cosa ne pensi del film di cui parlavamo?
turns.phon: GRAH-tsyeh ah TEH. ahl-LOH-rah, KOH-zah neh PEHN-see dehl FEELM dee KWEE par-lah-VAH-moh
turns.native: Thank you. So, what do you think of the film we were talking about?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sinceramente, da un lato è ben fatto, dall'altro è troppo lungo.
turns.phon: seen-cheh-rah-MEHN-teh, dah oon LAH-toh eh behn FAHT-toh, dahl-LAHL-troh eh TROHP-poh LOON-goh
turns.native: Honestly, on the one hand it's well made, on the other it's too long.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: È vero, ma la storia è bellissima. Io ho pianto alla fine!
turns.phon: eh VEH-roh, mah lah STOH-ryah eh behl-LEES-see-mah. EE-oh oh PYAHN-toh AHL-lah FEE-neh
turns.native: That's true, but the story is beautiful. I cried at the end!

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Davvero? Se ho capito bene, pensi che valga la pena vederlo al cinema.
turns.phon: dahv-VEH-roh. seh oh kah-PEE-toh BEH-neh, PEHN-see keh VAHL-gah lah PEH-nah veh-DEHR-loh ahl CHEE-neh-mah
turns.native: Really? If I've understood correctly, you think it's worth seeing at the cinema.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Esatto. Hai ragione sulla lunghezza, però non mi sono annoiata un minuto.
turns.phon: eh-ZAHT-toh. AH-ee rah-JOH-neh SOOL-lah loon-GEHT-tsah, peh-ROH nohn mee SOH-noh ahn-noh-YAH-tah oon mee-NOO-toh
turns.native: Exactly. You're right about the length, but I wasn't bored for a minute.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: In sintesi, non siamo d'accordo, ma va bene così!
turns.phon: een SEEN-teh-zee, nohn SYAH-moh dahk-KOR-doh, mah vah BEH-neh koh-ZEE
turns.native: In short, we don't agree, but that's fine!

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Come sempre! A proposito, come sta tua madre?
turns.phon: KOH-meh SEHM-preh. ah proh-POH-zee-toh, KOH-meh stah TOO-ah MAH-dreh
turns.native: As always! By the way, how is your mother?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Meglio, grazie. È tornata a casa ieri. Beh, si è fatto tardi, devo andare.
turns.phon: MEH-lyoh, GRAH-tsyeh. eh tor-NAH-tah ah KAH-zah YEH-ree. beh, see eh FAHT-toh TAR-dee, DEH-voh ahn-DAH-reh
turns.native: Better, thanks. She came home yesterday. Well, it's getting late, I have to go.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Salutamela! Ci sentiamo presto, buonanotte!
turns.phon: sah-LOO-tah-meh-lah. chee sehn-TYAH-moh PREHS-toh, bwoh-nah-NOHT-teh
turns.native: Say hi to her from me! Speak soon, good night!

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

readiness: Hold a sustained conversation: tell a story with time markers and feelings, give and defend an opinion (da un lato… dall'altro), concede (è vero, ma…), restate the other person's view, change the subject and say a warm goodbye.
